original.target_description: Gettinger et al. (2021), section 3.1.1.2, training reading passages: baseline versus intervention oral reading fluency (WCPM), six Grade 2 teacher-student dyads, omnibus multiple-baseline randomization comparison with associated average bias-corrected g. Printed journal p.13 matches supplied locator.

n.sample_role: student participants, each paired with one implementing teacher; six teacher-student dyads in the multiple-baseline analyses
n.exclusions: All six participating dyads were included in primary analyses; no additional exclusions for the training-passage test are reported.

replication.target_description: Gettinger et al. (2024), Academic and behavior combined support: A single-case practice-based replication study. Full text not acquired; abstract and section previews were not accepted as full-paper evidence.

notes: Original p.13 identifies the training-passage comparison. The effect size is the printed average g for that outcome, and p is the randomization-test result for the same baseline/intervention outcome. The authors caution on p.12 that summary effect sizes compare A/B observations and are not directly connected to the structured omnibus randomization statistic; they are not identical estimands. Replication not inferred from its abstract or section previews.
